policies.refund: Fees are refundable within 7 days of joining if you are not satisfied, after deducting a registration fee. After 7 days, fees are non-refundable.
policies.study_material: Printed study material and practice sheets are included in the fee.
policies.test_series: A chapter test every two weeks and three mock board exams a year.
policies.attendance_sms: Parents receive an attendance SMS for every class.
policies.doubt_sessions: Free doubt-clearing sessions twice a week.
policies.parking: Two-wheeler parking is available at Andheri and Borivali; limited at Dadar and Thane.
policies.online: Classes are offline at the branches; recorded revision videos are shared for missed classes.
policies.batch_size: Maximum 28–35 students per batch depending on the branch.

results_policy: We share past results only at the centre. We never guarantee marks, ranks or selection.

faqs.q: What are the fees for Class 8 Foundation?
faqs.a: Class 8 Foundation is ₹38,000 per year.

faqs.q: What are the fees for Class 9?
faqs.a: Class 9 (SSC / CBSE / ICSE) is ₹52,000 per year.

faqs.q: What are the fees for Class 10 Board Prep?
faqs.a: Class 10 Board Prep is ₹58,000 per year.

faqs.q: What are the fees for JEE Foundation?
faqs.a: JEE Foundation (Class 9–10) is ₹68,000 per year.

faqs.q: What are the fees for NEET Foundation?
faqs.a: NEET Foundation (Class 9–10) is ₹72,000 per year.
